scope: Local definition-only mathematical recomputation; neither external certification nor empirical prediction.
method: Sign-paired binomial generating moments; exact spherical monomial averaging; homogenized Legendre harmonic and vertex normalization; independent 110-digit original-symbol evaluation with analytic remainder bounds.

provenance.files_read_scope: Task-content files; Python and installed numerical-library implementation files are not mathematical inputs.

provenance_revision.change: Recorded task-content paths relative to the repository root instead of machine-local absolute paths.

conventions.I6_homogeneous: |p|^6*I6(p/|p|); its restriction to the unit sphere is the packet's I6.

scale_free_ratios.note: These are invariant under a rescaling and an overall multiplicative normalization of omega_squared. Angular normalization is fixed by the packet.

broken_control.mutation: Remove the final unit direction exactly once, leaving eleven equally weighted ports.
broken_control.test: For H2=p^T*T*p, require T-tr(T)*Identity/3 to vanish exactly.

direct_symbol_check.symbol_evaluation: Original sum(1-cos(a*k*u.n))/(2*a^2); independent sin-squared identity cross-check.
direct_symbol_check.bound_justification: Taylor degree seven with bounded eighth cosine derivative; its degree-seven polynomial equals the degree-six truncation.
